mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because it showed how oxygen reaches the blood and how carbon dioxide leaves it. The result could be clearer about which thin walls the gases cross.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding breathing muscles to the lungs was the least engaging decision because it was the only combination offered. Its explanation of the diaphragm and ribs was useful, though.

surprise.text: The final route clarified that blood returns to the heart after passing through the lungs before going onward to the body.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each had a clear purpose in building the air or blood route. The menu supplied compatible choices, so I did not have to discover their compatibility.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the model connects oxygen delivery to the arm's work. The explanations held my interest, although the limited choices made the play predictable.
